assessment: In this work, the authors introduce and develop upon a computational model to investigate and quantify the effect of protein conformations and valence of interaction sites as organizers of structure within biomolecular condensates. The authors integrate their findings with new and emerging concepts regarding the coupling between phase separation and percolation as a determinant of driving forces and internal organization of condensates. The key insight that emerges from the current work pertains to the structure that prevails across length scales.
